projectDescription: A personal AI agent with its own phone number, email inbox, and cloud computer — tied exclusively to you.
keyFeatures: Personal iMessage line — your agent has its own dedicated phone number
Agent email inbox at <username>@wzrd.tech with full send/receive support
Dedicated cloud computer (Box VM) per user for persistent agent memory and file storage
Streaming AI chat via web, iMessage, and desktop with shared conversation history
Needs You approval queue for email drafts, ad writes, and agent decisions
Social media publishing to Instagram, TikTok, Meta Ads, and YouTube
Ad campaign management with spend caps, analytics, and approval gates
Skills hub for installing and managing agent capabilities
Composio connectors for OAuth integrations (Gmail, GitHub, etc.)
Mini-apps: interactive iMessage cards for Kanban, To-Do, and Computer Use
Crypto wallet with balance, QR funding, and transaction history
Brand kit editor with typography, palette, and voice guidelines
Sender trust tiers: owner, known contacts, and unknown senders
Speed & Intelligence tier selector (Fast, Balanced, Deep)
publicApiSurface: GET /api/chat/[runId]/events — SSE stream of run events
POST /api/decisions — approve or dismiss a decision
POST /api/connectors — create a Composio OAuth link session
POST /api/skills — install or uninstall a skill
POST /api/assets — ingest a box asset and mint delivery URL
GET /api/wallet — wallet summary and QR code
POST /api/slots — schedule a new content slot
POST /api/ads/writes — propose an ad write action
GET /api/me — current user profile and agent addresses
POST /api/mini/link — mint a mini-app token URL
